question: Among players who weigh more than 200 lbs, list the 10 heaviest with their weight and their height in centimetres rounded to a whole number.
evidence: weight > 200; a player is identified by player_name and weight; heaviest refers to weight DESC, ties broken by player_name; height rounded refers to ROUND(height)
gold_sql: SELECT player_name, weight, ROUND(height) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_name, weight, height FROM Player WHERE weight > 200) ORDER BY weight DESC, player_name LIMIT 10

question: In the first five stages of the 2015/2016 season, which league had the most matches that ended in a draw?
evidence: first five stages refers to stage <= 5; draw refers to home_team_goal = away_team_goal; the league of a match is its home team's league; a match is identified by its home team, away team and date; ties broken by league name
gold_sql: SELECT league FROM (SELECT DISTINCT home.team_long_name AS home_team, away.team_long_name AS away_team, SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) AS match_day, lg.name AS league, ct.name AS country, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.stage <= 5 AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal) GROUP BY league ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, league LIMIT 1

question: Among players who weigh at least 200 lbs and were born between 1990 and 1995, how many are taller than the average height of that group?
evidence: weight >= 200; born between 1990 and 1995 refers to SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995'; a player is identified by player_name and weight; count distinct players
gold_sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT DISTINCT player_name, weight, height FROM Player WHERE weight >= 200 AND SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grp WHERE height > (SELECT AVG(height) FROM grp)

question: Which players with a heading accuracy of at least 80 in a 2015 attribute record are at least 185 cm tall, were born in 1991 or later, and prefer their left foot?
evidence: 2015 attribute record refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2015'; heading_accuracy >= 80; height >= 185; born in 1991 or later refers to SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) >= '1991'; preferred_foot = 'left'
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2015' AND pa.heading_accuracy >= 80 AND p.height >= 185 AND SUBSTR(p.birthday, 1, 4) >= '1991' AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

question: Which league had the most goals in the first three stages of the 2015/2016 season?
evidence: first three stages refers to stage <= 3; goals refers to SUM(home_team_goal + away_team_goal); a match is identified by its home team, away team and date; ties broken by league name
gold_sql: SELECT league FROM (SELECT DISTINCT home.team_long_name AS home_team, away.team_long_name AS away_team, SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) AS match_day, lg.name AS league, ct.name AS country, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.stage <= 3) GROUP BY league ORDER BY SUM(home_team_goal + away_team_goal) DESC, league LIMIT 1

question: In the 2009/2010 season, counting only matches played from 1 January 2010, which away team won the most Scotland Premier League matches in which it scored at least two goals?
evidence: 2009/2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; from 1 January 2010 refers to date >= '2010-01-01'; away team won refers to away_team_goal > home_team_goal; scored at least two goals refers to away_team_goal >= 2; a match is identified by its home team, away team and date; ties broken by team name
gold_sql: SELECT away_team FROM (SELECT DISTINCT home.team_long_name AS home_team, away.team_long_name AS away_team, SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) AS match_day, lg.name AS league, ct.name AS country, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.date >= '2010-01-01' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND lg.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.away_team_goal >= 2) GROUP BY away_team ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, away_team LIMIT 1

question: Which leagues had at least one match with six or more goals in the first ten stages of the 2015/2016 season?
evidence: first ten stages refers to stage <= 10; six or more goals refers to home_team_goal + away_team_goal >= 6
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT lg.name FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.stage <= 10 AND m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal >= 6

question: Among the 2016 attribute records with an overall rating of at least 75, what percentage belong to left-footed players with a crossing score of at least 75?
evidence: 2016 attribute records refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2016'; overall_rating >= 75; crossing >= 75; left-footed refers to preferred_foot = 'left'; an attribute record is identified by the player (player_name and weight) and the record date; percentage = 100.0 * count of such records / count of all records
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN crossing >= 75 AND preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, p.weight, pa.date AS record_date, pa.crossing, pa.preferred_foot FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2016' AND pa.overall_rating >= 75)

question: In the first three stages of the 2012/2013 season, which leagues scored more goals than the average league?
evidence: first three stages refers to stage <= 3; a match is identified by its home team, away team and date; a league's goals = SUM(home_team_goal + away_team_goal) over its matches; the average league's goals = total goals / number of leagues with matches in that period
gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT league, home_team_goal + away_team_goal AS goals FROM (SELECT DISTINCT home.team_long_name AS home_team, away.team_long_name AS away_team, SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) AS match_day, lg.name AS league, ct.name AS country, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2012/2013' AND m.stage <= 3)) SELECT league FROM g GROUP BY league HAVING SUM(goals) > (SELECT SUM(goals) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT league) FROM g)

question: Which matches played in December 2009 were won by the home team, had more than three goals, and were played in the England Premier League? Give the home team, the away team and the date.
evidence: December 2009 refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 7) = '2009-12'; won by the home team refers to home_team_goal > away_team_goal; more than three goals refers to home_team_goal + away_team_goal > 3; a match is identified by its home team, away team and date
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT home.team_long_name, away.team_long_name, SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-12' AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal > 3 AND lg.name = 'England Premier League'
